// Command gen applies migrations with the sql-migrate based go-dbkit MigrationsManager
// (commit d3d5fd68712baf09e6ca498f7250751234aca9f1) and prints the resulting history.
// With -export-mssql it also writes an SQL export built from SQL Server catalog metadata and rows.
//
// It is built in a temporary module that replaces github.com/acronis/go-dbkit with the old checkout.
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/acronis/go-appkit/log"
	_ "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	_ "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"

	"github.com/acronis/go-dbkit"
	"github.com/acronis/go-dbkit/migrate"
)

// LongID is the applied migration ID longer than 255 characters, used on PostgreSQL only (id is TEXT there).
var LongID = "4_" + strings.Repeat("long_migration_id_", 17) // 2 + 306 characters.

func migrations(dialect dbkit.Dialect) []migrate.Migration {
	str, unicodeName := "VARCHAR(100)", "'Zoë 東京'"
	if dialect == dbkit.DialectMSSQL {
		str, unicodeName = "NVARCHAR(100)", "N'Zoë 東京'"
	}
	migs := []migrate.Migration{
		migrate.NewCustomMigration("1_create_users",
			[]string{"CREATE TABLE legacy_users (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name " + str + " NOT NULL)"},
			[]string{"DROP TABLE legacy_users"}, nil, nil),
		migrate.NewCustomMigration("2_seed_users",
			[]string{
				"INSERT INTO legacy_users (id, name) VALUES (1, 'alice')",
				"INSERT INTO legacy_users (id, name) VALUES (2, " + unicodeName + ")",
				"INSERT INTO legacy_users (id, name) VALUES (3, 'untouched')",
			},
			[]string{"DELETE FROM legacy_users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3)"}, nil, nil),
		migrate.NewCustomMigration("3_create_audit",
			[]string{
				"CREATE TABLE legacy_audit (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, note " + str + " NOT NULL)",
				"INSERT INTO legacy_audit (id, note) VALUES (1, 'created by 3')",
			},
			[]string{"DROP TABLE legacy_audit"}, nil, nil),
	}
	if dialect == dbkit.DialectPostgres {
		migs = append(migs, migrate.NewCustomMigration(LongID,
			[]string{"INSERT INTO legacy_audit (id, note) VALUES (4, 'long id')"},
			[]string{"DELETE FROM legacy_audit WHERE id = 4"}, nil, nil))
	}
	return migs
}

func main() {
	dialect := flag.String("dialect", "", "dbkit dialect: sqlite3, postgres, mysql, mssql")
	driver := flag.String("driver", "", "database/sql driver name")
	dsn := flag.String("dsn", "", "data source name")
	exportMSSQL := flag.String("export-mssql", "", "write an SQL Server export of the fixture tables to this file")
	flag.Parse()

	db, err := sql.Open(*driver, *dsn)
	check(err)
	defer db.Close()
	check(db.Ping())

	d := dbkit.Dialect(*dialect)
	mm, err := migrate.NewMigrationsManager(db, d, log.NewDisabledLogger())
	check(err)
	migs := migrations(d)
	for range migs {
		check(mm.RunLimit(migs, migrate.MigrationsDirectionUp, 1))
		time.Sleep(1100 * time.Millisecond) // Distinct timestamps at second precision.
	}

	status, err := mm.Status()
	check(err)
	for _, m := range status.AppliedMigrations {
		fmt.Printf("%s\t%s\n", m.ID, m.AppliedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
	}

	if *exportMSSQL != "" {
		f, err := os.Create(*exportMSSQL)
		check(err)
		check(exportSQLServer(db, f, []string{"migrations", "legacy_users", "legacy_audit"}))
		check(f.Close())
	}
}

// exportSQLServer writes CREATE TABLE statements built from sys catalog metadata and INSERT statements for all rows.
// Batches are separated by GO lines.
func exportSQLServer(db *sql.DB, f *os.File, tables []string) error {
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "-- SQL Server export of go-dbkit fixture tables, generated from sys catalog metadata and rows.\n")
	for _, table := range tables {
		cols, err := sqlServerColumns(db, table)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		pk, err := sqlServerPrimaryKey(db, table)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defs := make([]string, 0, len(cols)+1)
		for _, c := range cols {
			def := "[" + c.name + "] " + c.typeSQL()
			if c.nullable {
				def += " NULL"
			} else {
				def += " NOT NULL"
			}
			defs = append(defs, def)
		}
		if len(pk) > 0 {
			defs = append(defs, "PRIMARY KEY ("+"["+strings.Join(pk, "], [")+"]"+")")
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(f, "CREATE TABLE [dbo].[%s] (\n    %s\n);\nGO\n", table, strings.Join(defs, ",\n    "))
		if err = sqlServerRows(db, f, table, cols); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type sqlServerColumn struct {
	name      string
	typeName  string
	maxLength int // Bytes; -1 for MAX.
	nullable  bool
}

func (c sqlServerColumn) typeSQL() string {
	switch c.typeName {
	case "varchar", "char", "varbinary", "binary":
		if c.maxLength < 0 {
			return c.typeName + "(MAX)"
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%d)", c.typeName, c.maxLength)
	case "nvarchar", "nchar":
		if c.maxLength < 0 {
			return c.typeName + "(MAX)"
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%d)", c.typeName, c.maxLength/2)
	case "int", "bigint", "datetime", "datetime2", "datetimeoffset":
		return c.typeName
	default:
		panic("unsupported SQL Server type " + c.typeName)
	}
}

func sqlServerColumns(db *sql.DB, table string) ([]sqlServerColumn, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query(`SELECT c.name, t.name, c.max_length, c.is_nullable
FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(?) ORDER BY c.column_id`, "dbo."+table)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var cols []sqlServerColumn
	for rows.Next() {
		var c sqlServerColumn
		if err = rows.Scan(&c.name, &c.typeName, &c.maxLength, &c.nullable); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		cols = append(cols, c)
	}
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("table %s not found", table)
	}
	return cols, rows.Err()
}

func sqlServerPrimaryKey(db *sql.DB, table string) ([]string, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query(`SELECT c.name
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID(?) AND i.is_primary_key = 1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal`, "dbo."+table)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var cols []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var name string
		if err = rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		cols = append(cols, name)
	}
	return cols, rows.Err()
}

// sqlServerRows writes one INSERT per row. Strings are written as N'' literals with doubled quotes; datetime values as
// ISO 8601 literals with milliseconds, which convert back to the same DATETIME value (1/300 s ticks).
func sqlServerRows(db *sql.DB, f *os.File, table string, cols []sqlServerColumn) error {
	names := make([]string, len(cols))
	for i, c := range cols {
		names[i] = "[" + c.name + "]"
	}
	rows, err := db.Query(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT %s FROM [dbo].[%s] ORDER BY 1", strings.Join(names, ", "), table))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	for rows.Next() {
		vals := make([]any, len(cols))
		ptrs := make([]any, len(cols))
		for i := range vals {
			ptrs[i] = &vals[i]
		}
		if err = rows.Scan(ptrs...); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lits := make([]string, len(cols))
		for i, v := range vals {
			switch v := v.(type) {
			case nil:
				lits[i] = "NULL"
			case int64:
				lits[i] = fmt.Sprint(v)
			case string:
				lits[i] = "N'" + strings.ReplaceAll(v, "'", "''") + "'"
			case time.Time:
				lits[i] = "CONVERT(DATETIME, '" + v.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.000") + "', 126)"
			default:
				return fmt.Errorf("unsupported value %T in %s", v, table)
			}
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(f, "INSERT INTO [dbo].[%s] (%s) VALUES (%s);\nGO\n", table, strings.Join(names, ", "), strings.Join(lits, ", "))
	}
	return rows.Err()
}

func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
